name: Amy Acton
summary:
Amy Leigh Acton (née Stearns, formerly Beech; born February 16, 1966) is an American physician and politician who is the governor-elect of Ohio. She previously served as the director of the Ohio Department of Health, in which capacity she led Ohio's COVID-19 pandemic response from 2019 to 2020 under governor Mike DeWine.
Acton was born and raised in Youngstown, Ohio.
